## Mathematical verification (primary sources read in full text)
Read RS arXiv:0803.2722v3 §2.4–2.7, §3–§6 (including the LaTeX source to settle the `ufs_cs`/`ufs_sc` convention of Props 5.3/5.4), Reading math/0512339 §2–3, and Björner–Brenti Ch. 1–3; checked every item's statement, hypotheses, direction and strategy against them. Repairs made in this pass:
1. **`lem-cg-coxeter-word-transport-and-form-independence`** — replaced a garbled, effectively circular strategy for Coxeter-word reducedness with a clean induction via the positive-span lemma + root-length criterion; corrected a false `K`-identity in the Euler-form word-independence proof.
2. **`lem-cg-finite-rank-two-inversion-set-recognition`** — restated clause (3)(a) as closure under *positive rank-two combinations* (the sum-only form did not support the height-descent step) and replaced the proof of (i)⇒(ii) with a self-contained linearity/biclosedness + rank-two segment argument (removing a forward citation).
3. Dependency completion (10 items gained genuinely used deps), `justified_by` added for the skip-root definition, a hypothesis typo fixed (`w ≱_R s`), and RS 5.3/5.4 notation disambiguated.
4. One `dependency_level` changed (12→13); levels now match the checker for both pages.
